name: Exp_Volume_Weighted_MACandle
summary: This EA trades based on signals from the custom Volume Weighted MACandle indicator, opening buy positions when the indicator transitions to bullish (color=2) and sell positions when it transitions to bearish (color=0). It uses fixed stop loss and take profit levels with configurable money management and allows independent control of entry and exit directions.
summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义的成交量加权MA蜡烛指标信号进行交易，当指标转为看涨颜色(2)时开多仓，转为看跌颜色(0)时开空仓。使用固定止损止损和止盈水平，支持可配置的资金管理方式，并可独立控制买入和卖出方向的入场与出场。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念基于成交量加权移动平均线蜡烛指标，通过识别指标颜色的变化来判断市场动量方向。入场条件为：当指标当前颜色为2（看涨）且前一颜色小于2时开多仓，当指标当前颜色为0（看跌）且前一颜色大于0时开空仓。出场条件为：当指标转为看跌时平多仓，当指标转为看涨时平空仓，同时也设置了固定点数的止损（1000点）和止盈（2000点）。仓位管理使用MM参数控制仓位大小，支持固定手数或基于保证金比例的两种模式（LOT和FREEMARGIN）。资金管理通过MarginMode枚举选择固定手数或自由保证金比例模式，但缺少加仓、减仓或追踪止损等动态仓位调整机制。整体策略逻辑清晰，但完全依赖单一指标信号，缺乏多维度确认和动态风险管理。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on a Volume Weighted Moving Average Candle indicator that identifies market momentum direction through color transitions. Entry conditions: a buy position opens when the indicator's current color is 2 (bullish) and the previous color was less than 2, while a sell position opens when the current color is 0 (bearish) and the previous color was greater than 0. Exit conditions: long positions close when the indicator turns bearish, and short positions close when it turns bullish, with fixed stop loss (1000 points) and take profit (2000 points) as additional exit mechanisms. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter, supporting either fixed lot size or margin-based percentage mode via the MarginMode enum (LOT vs FREEMARGIN). Money management offers two modes but lacks dynamic position adjustment mechanisms such as scaling in/out, trailing stops, or volatility-based sizing. The overall strategy logic is clear but relies entirely on a single indicator signal without multi-dimensional confirmation or dynamic risk management.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 每笔交易的资金管理参数（手数或保证金比例）
parameters.description_en: Money management ratio, controls trade lot size

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 保证金模式（固定手数或自由保证金比例）
parameters.description_en: Lot calculation mode: Fixed lot or margin-based ratio

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 用于获取交易信号的K线索引

parameters.name: Length
parameters.description: 成交量加权MA的计算周期长度

parameters.name: VolumeType
parameters.description: 成交量类型（Tick成交量或真实成交量）
parameters.description_en: Volume type (Tick volume or Real volume)

pros: 策略逻辑清晰简洁，基于成交量加权指标能有效反映价格动量变化
支持独立控制买入和卖出方向的入场与出场，灵活性较高
使用新K线检测机制避免同一根K线内重复开仓，减少过度交易风险
止损止盈比例合理（1:2），符合正向期望的交易原则
支持两种资金管理模式，适应不同交易者需求
pros_en: Clear and concise strategy logic based on volume-weighted indicator that effectively reflects price momentum changes
Independent control over buy and sell entry/exit directions provides high flexibility
New bar detection mechanism prevents repeated entries within the same bar, reducing overtrading risk
Reasonable stop loss to take profit ratio (1:2) aligns with positive expectancy trading principles
Supports two money management modes to accommodate different trader preferences
cons: 完全依赖单一指标信号，缺乏多维度确认机制，容易产生虚假信号导致的亏损交易
止损和止盈为固定点数，未考虑市场波动率（ATR）动态调整，在不同市场环境下适应性差
缺少追踪止损机制，无法在趋势行情中锁定已有利润
没有持仓检查和重复开仓防护，可能在已有同方向持仓时再次开仓
指标句柄获取失败时的错误处理不够完善，仅打印信息后返回初始化失败，缺少重试机制
cons_en: Relies entirely on a single indicator signal without multi-dimensional confirmation, prone to false signal losses
Fixed point-based stop loss and take profit without ATR-based dynamic adjustment, poorly adaptive to varying market volatility
No trailing stop mechanism to lock in profits during trending markets
No position check or duplicate entry prevention, potentially opening additional positions in the same direction
Insufficient error handling when indicator handle fails - only prints a message and returns INIT_FAILED without retry logic
improvements: 增加多指标确认机制，如结合ATR过滤低波动信号或加入趋势过滤器（如更高时间周期MA方向），减少虚假信号
将止损止盈改为基于ATR的动态计算，并增加追踪止损功能，提升不同市场环境下的适应性和盈利能力
improvements_en: Add multi-indicator confirmation such as ATR-based volatility filtering or a higher timeframe trend filter (e.g., MA direction) to reduce false signals
Replace fixed stop loss/take profit with ATR-based dynamic calculation and add trailing stop functionality to improve adaptability and profitability across different market conditions

risk_points: 缺少持仓检查机制，可能在同方向已有仓位时重复开仓导致过度暴露
固定止损止盈未考虑市场波动率，在高波动市场中止损可能过小导致频繁止损
risk_points_en: No position check mechanism may cause duplicate entries in the same direction, leading to overexposure
Fixed stop loss/take profit without volatility consideration may result in frequent stop-outs during high volatility markets
